svg.aria-label: How Episode Info works: IINA tells the plugin when you pause or open a file, the plugin talks to the sidebar and the overlay and fetches information from TMDB and three subtitle sites; below, the pause-to-overlay flow and how subtitles are found
svg.title: Episode Info — How It Works

g.text: Know What You Are Watching, And Find Subtitles — Without Ever Leaving IINA.
Talks To The Sidebar And Overlay
Listens For What The Player Does
Waits Your Chosen Delay Before Showing
Never Hangs On A Slow Server
Opens The Backup Website For You
Three Subtitle Sources, Side By Side
Air Date And Synopsis — Right On The Video
These Are The Only Sites It Contacts.
Pause The Video. A Moment Later The Card Slides In. Press Play And It Disappears.
Rating, Air Date And Synopsis From TMDB
Each Source Is Searched On Its Own, Casting A Wider Net Each Time, Until Something Comes Back.
You Can Also Search Each One Yourself
Still Nothing? One Click Opens The OpenSubtitles Website, Already Filtered For You
The First Source To Come Back With Something Wins. Zipped Files Are Unpacked For You Automatically.
